interactions.name: Demand × Conversion × Capacity
interactions.mechanism: Demand creates opportunity; conversion advances it; capacity determines response and delivery. More demand into a conversion/capacity constraint can lower economics and quality.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Demand can raise queue/response delay, lowering conversion; weak conversion can encourage wasteful acquisition.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if added qualified demand raises profitable throughput without response, conversion or capacity deterioration.

interactions.name: Growth × Unit Economics × Cash
interactions.mechanism: Growth multiplies unit economics and creates timing/capital needs.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Cash stress can force choices that worsen economics and retention.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if scaled cohorts improve contribution and cash within stated assumptions.

interactions.name: Constraint × Operations × Capacity
interactions.mechanism: Only capacity/quality at the active constraint raises system throughput.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Local optimization releases more work into the constraint and increases WIP.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if non-constraint improvement raises throughput without affecting claimed constraint.

interactions.name: Offer × Positioning × Pricing × Conversion
interactions.mechanism: Differential value and proof affect willingness to pay, conversion, margin and fit.
interactions.misleading_interpretation: Discount or better creative automatically fixes conversion.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Discounting can raise poor-fit conversion and damage delivery/retention.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if offer/price changes do not change relevant conversion/realization under comparable demand.

interactions.name: Retention × Acquisition × LTV
interactions.mechanism: Retention/repeat/referral determine lifetime contribution and replacement demand.
interactions.misleading_interpretation: Acquisition alone is the growth engine.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Weak retention increases acquisition need; poor acquisition fit reduces retention.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if acquisition cohorts sustain contribution despite low repeat/retention by model design.

interactions.name: Founder Capability × Systems × Leverage
interactions.mechanism: Exceptional founder judgment can produce results while masking missing transferable systems.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Founder rescue prevents system learning and role ownership.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if outcomes remain stable without founder involvement.

interactions.name: Accountability × Incentives × Execution
interactions.mechanism: Ownership, authority, standards, feedback, consequence and incentives shape fidelity and learning.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Misaligned incentives produce rational local behavior and false reporting.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if clarified rights/incentives do not affect fidelity.

interactions.name: Measurement × False Causality × Resource Allocation
interactions.mechanism: Invalid causal assumptions direct money/time toward non-drivers.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Resources reinforce the metric, making it look increasingly important.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens when intervention on metric reliably changes outcome with fidelity/confounds addressed.

interactions.name: Business Model × Demand × Margin
interactions.mechanism: An effective demand engine can be structurally incompatible with margins or cash.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Demand growth can accelerate capital destruction.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if source-level cohorts demonstrate positive contribution/payback.

interactions.name: Business Model × Delivery × Retention
interactions.mechanism: The model fails if delivery cannot sustain promise, quality or economics.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Poor delivery increases churn/recovery and raises acquisition burden.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if delivery/retention/economics remain healthy at scale.

interactions.name: Growth × Complexity × Organization
interactions.mechanism: Volume/scope increase coordination, decision and exception load.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: More people create more coordination and founder rescue.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if productive capacity and quality outpace coordination cost.

interactions.name: Concentration × Resilience × Cash
interactions.mechanism: Channel/customer/key-person dependency can turn a shock into liquidity/survival risk.
interactions.misleading_interpretation: Concentration is always efficient or always bad.
interactions.delayed_effects: Inspect the business-model-appropriate lag before conclusion.
interactions.feedback_loops: Loss reduces cash and constrains adaptation, deepening dependency.
interactions.falsifier: Claim weakens if replacement/contingency evidence and cash protection are strong.
